predicted_error.description: Uncertainty in the mass weights (instance mode), above 0: small = precise, 1 = rough. Default 0.3

n_suggestions.description: Number of suggested next compositions to return (at least 1). Default 5

instance.description: Infer unknown phase composition from measured XRD data via Bayesian inference. Inputs are provided inline; results are written as suggestion files and a plot.

elements.description: Elements in the phase field: 3 or 4 element symbols, e.g. Fe, Mn, Ti

composition.description: Measured sample composition as a formula using only the phase-field elements, e.g. Fe2Mn4Ti4

knowns.description: Known phases identified by XRD: 1 to 3 formulas using only the phase-field elements, e.g. FeMn

mass_weights.description: Rietveld mass fraction of each known phase, above 0, in the same order as knowns (may be left empty for a single known)

dataset.description: Batch inference from a JSON input file describing the phase field and one or more samples.

file.description: JSON file: "phase_field" (type uncharged / charged / charge_ranges / custom, and its elements) and "samples" (each with composition, 1-3 knowns and their mass_weights); optional n_suggestions, n_l, n_p, min_dist, plot

results.zip.description: All output files as a zip archive
